description: This is an agent-based model that simulates the spread of a virus in a population of 1000 individuals. Each individual is represented as an agent with specific attributes and behaviors influencing the dynamics of virus transmission.

behaviors.name: move
behaviors.description: Person moves randomly within the environment.
behaviors.algorithm: Each person moves to a random adjacent location within a specified range.

behaviors.name: interact
behaviors.description: Person interacts with other persons in close proximity.
behaviors.algorithm: Determine potential interactions within a specified radius.

behaviors.name: infect
behaviors.description: An infected person may transmit the virus to a susceptible person.
behaviors.algorithm: If an infected person interacts with a susceptible person, a random check against the infection probability determines if the susceptible person becomes infected.

behaviors.name: recover
behaviors.description: An infected person recovers after a certain period.
behaviors.algorithm: Track infection duration for each person; change status to recovered after the recovery time is reached.

interactions.name: infection_event
interactions.description: When a person with the virus interacts with a susceptible person, there is a chance of transmission.
interactions.effect: The susceptible person becomes infected based on the infection probability.

files.name: main.py
files.description: Main simulation script that initializes and runs the simulation.

files.name: person.py
files.description: Defines the Person class, attributes, and behaviors.

files.name: environment.py
files.description: Sets up the simulation environment, including grid configuration.

files.name: metrics.py
files.description: Calculates and records simulation metrics like total infections, peak infection day, and recovery count.
